name: Acid
doc: Acid (enemy attack 35, Tri-Face's): Gastric Juice's design with one stream - a splash at the caster's mouth, an acid blob running down a curve to near the first target, a landing mesh, drips and puddles there, the target melting down into the ground and back; the sound; the damage at tick 46. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag170_acid.cpp) run on the program's memory (its droplets, curve and queues in the module).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: The director's and the stream's ticks: the sound, the stream and its curve, the damage; the texture and the camera

parts.title: Splash
parts.doc: Droplets bursting out of the caster's mouth along its direction, slowing, fading

parts.title: Blob
parts.doc: The acid blob (4 sprites, smaller and smaller) running down the curve, slowing

parts.title: Landing mesh
parts.doc: A mesh at the landing point morphing between two shapes, growing, fading in and out

parts.title: Drips
parts.doc: Droplets falling around the landing point (a table: how many on each of the first 13 ticks)

parts.title: Puddles
parts.doc: Puddle meshes around the landing point, each after its own delay, growing, fading

parts.title: Melting target
parts.doc: The first target redrawn melting down toward the ground beyond the plane through the landing point, then back
